notes.title: New Mage Unit + Balance Updates
notes.notes: [list][*][p]Added a new Mage Skeleton unit + building that requires Magicka[/p][/*][*][p]Base can now go up to level 3 to unlock Magicka[/p][/*][*][p]Removed unit selection so it's easier to select buildings[/p][/*][*][p]FPS fix for plunder units[/p][/*][*][p]FPS fix for towers[/p][/*][*][p]Re-balanced unit stats and costs[/p][/*][*][p]The two starting towers in the middle lane now only have 250 health (500 before)[/p][/*][*][p]Slightly reduced tower range[/p][/*][*][p]Food & Wood Outposts cost increased to 200 wood (100 before)[/p][/*][*][p]Basic Graveyard cost decreased to 200 wood (500 before)[/p][/*][*][p]Reduced food upkeep for all units by a lot - so you don't have to spam so many Food Outposts[/p][/*][*][p]Reworked how buildings are built - they now first take wood, then stone then magicka[/p][/*][*][p]Adjusted hotkeys - Tower is now on 8, new Magic Graveyard is now on 7[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: FPS + Balance Update + Selection bugfix (test)
notes.notes: [list][*][p]Made some changes to how selecting buildings works, hopefully this will fix the selection bug, but it needs testing[/p][/*][*][p]Reduced the amount of units and made all units slightly stronger[/p][/*][*][p]Increased health of economy units to reduce tower effiency[/p][/*][*][p]Economy units (builders and plunderers) no longer attack, they just cower in fear (stand still) when an enemy is too close[/p][/*][*][p]Removed extra unit upgrades[/p][/*][*][p]Slightly adjusted combat unit logic to increase FPS[/p][/*][*][p]Adjusted building costs, unit costs and starting resources[/p][/*][/list][p]Please report any bugs, feedback or requests on Discord: [url="https://discord.com/invite/tsmeD5QwEM"]https://discord.com/invite/tsmeD5QwEM[/url][/p]

notes.title: Balancing Update + Lobby Fix
notes.notes: [list][*][p]There was a bug that only allowed one lobby to be open at the time. This has hopefully been fixed.[/p][/*][*][p]Adjusted building and unit costs so wood becomes much more important at the start and stone is something you can (optionally) transition into.[/p][/*][*][p]Removed the option to build stone buildings at the start, you can upgrade the base to unlock stone buildings.[/p][/*][*][p]Builders now pause for 12 seconds if they do not have enough resources to continue building. This allows economy units to spawn so your economy does not completely break.[/p][/*][/list][p]There's still a major bug in the selection system, I'm trying to fix this asap. If you cannot select buildings, completely close the game and restart, that should fix it.[/p][p]I'm aware the building and selection systems are not optimal, this will be fixed in the future. For now, just click around a bit until you get the right building selected. If builders are blocking your selection, you can send them away by starting a building somewhere far away and then destroying the building. Or just destroy the builder.[/p]

notes.title: Economy and Tower update
notes.notes: [list][*][p]Economy spawners now spawn 5 units each instead of 2. They can be futher upgraded to spawn up to 10 units.[/p][/*][*][p]Added an upgrade to the base that lets you add armor to all economy units - very useful against towers.[/p][/*][*][p]Updated unit costs and stats.[/p][/*][/list][p]There's one game breaking bug I know about out there. Sometimes the 2nd player is not able to select anything. When this happens it's best to just restart the game. You need to be able to select things to upgrade them, which is a big part of the game. I'm trying to fix this, but it's proving very hard to figure out.[/p][p]Please @ me on Discord if you'd like to play: [url="https://discord.com/invite/tsmeD5QwEM"]https://discord.com/invite/tsmeD5QwEM[/url][/p]

notes.title: Added macOS support
notes.notes:
The game should now also work on macOS.
Let me know on Discord if there are any issues.

notes.title: Update 2025/08/12 - 1
notes.notes:
- Balanced economy
- Reduced the amount of units and made units stronger
- Adjusted a lot of damage and health values for everything
- Reworked Combat Unit logic, game should run better now at higher unit counts
- Plunderers now stand still and fight back if enemy units are in range
- Added Victory/Defeat messages at the end of the game
- Fixed an FPS limit issue in the starting menu
- Added a button to disable spawning Combat Units

notes.title: Small Update
notes.notes:
Added Golem animation and adjusted their attacks.
Added Builder pathing.
Rotated Camera for player 2 and adjusted camera starting locations for both players.
Fixed Party Menu authentication error.

notes.title: Hotfix for last update
notes.notes:
Fixed tower position
Fixed healthbars getting wrong color sometimes
Changed unit spawn costs so Plunderers will always spawn before Combat Units

notes.title: Small Update
notes.notes:
Fixed a bug where Plunderers would stop working when their Spawner was destroyed.
Fixed a bug where Farms would only spawn one Farmer. They now spawn 5 again.
Fixed a bug that wouldn't allow selecting/deselecting things properly.

Added healthbar colors.
Adjusted the position of the towers in the middle.

notes.title: Small Fixes
notes.notes: Adjusted building zone on top of the walls to prevent buildings hanging over the wall and units being able to target them from below.

notes.title: Big Update
notes.notes:
- Towers have more health but less damage
- All units have been updated
- Updated some visuals
- Added some animations
- Added tooltips to building buttons on hover

The game should be in a testable state right now, though still far from finished. Please report any bugs on Discord.

notes.title: Hotfix for last update
notes.notes:
The last update completely broke the game.
This should fix it.

notes.title: Big Rework
notes.notes:
- Plunderers now only plunder resources
- Combat units only move towards the enemy base and fight
- Added Food - Units won't spawn if you run out of food
- Reworked the map, there are 3 lanes now, each split into 3 lines, combat units will follow the line closest to their spawn building
- Combat units will now also attack any buildings
- Added some better unit movement, still a work in progress

notes.title: Small Update
notes.notes:
- Added health bars
- Reduced plunderable wood
- Increased plunderable stone
- Increased build power
- Added hotkeys for building
- Increased camera speed + press shift to move even faster
- Camera angle changed from perspective to orthogonal
